tools.name: alphayou_search_datasets
tools.description: What data AlphaYou has and which tool returns it, with each tool's plan and cost. Costs no requests. Call this first to decide what to call next. Optional q filters the list by a word.

tools.name: alphayou_funds
tools.description: The institutional investment managers whose Form 13F filings AlphaYou tracks: latest reporting period, filing date, position count, the total value the filer reported and the SEC filing link. Raw filing data, biggest reported value first, the same for every user. Pages with nextCursor.

tools.name: alphayou_company_disclosures
tools.description: Recent SEC 8-K filings for one US-listed company, read from SEC EDGAR: the items filed (with their titles), the filing date and the original SEC link. Up to 20 recent filings, newest first, with totalInWindow and truncated marking omitted rows. Metadata only, not article text, news or sentiment; no

tools.name: alphayou_insider_trades
tools.description: Insider open-market buys and sells from SEC Form 4 filings, newest first: the insider, their role, each trade with date, shares and price, the 10b5-1 plan label and the SEC link. Optional ticker, side (buy or sell) and days. Free keys get the 5 newest filings from the last 90 days; Pro keys page thr

tools.name: alphayou_insider_clusters
tools.description: Companies where several different insiders filed an open-market buy (or sale) on SEC Form 4 inside a short window: how many insiders, how many filings, how many under a 10b5-1 plan, and who. A plain count with its parameters shown (side, days up to 90, minimum insiders), not a score or a prediction.

tools.name: alphayou_fund_holdings
tools.description: One tracked fund's newest Form 13F book, biggest position first: issuer, CUSIP, ticker where mapped, value, shares and the share change against the fund's previous filing. Long US-listed positions only, as of a quarter end and filed up to 45 days later, so not the fund's book today. Use a cik from a

tools.name: alphayou_fund_changes
tools.description: What one tracked fund changed between its newest Form 13F and the one before: new positions, adds, trims and exits, largest estimated trade first, with the share counts in both filings. The trade size is an estimate from quarter-end prices, not a fill price, and nothing inside the quarter is visible

tools.name: alphayou_ticker_holders
tools.description: Which tracked funds list one stock in their newest Form 13F, biggest position first, with the share change against each fund's previous filing. Only the funds alphayou_funds lists, not every institution, and none found does not prove nobody holds it. Long positions as of a quarter end, filed up to 4

tools.name: alphayou_top_traders
tools.description: Positions the top tracked traders currently hold in Hyperliquid perpetual contracts linked to US stocks: side, size, entry price and unrealized profit. These are contracts on Hyperliquid, not share holdings, so never say a trader owns the stock. An annualised ROI at the 10000% ceiling is withheld (r

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_wallets_positions
tools.description: Live open positions for 1 to 25 Hyperliquid wallets in one call, read from Hyperliquid now across the main exchange and every builder market, so stock-linked contracts such as xyz:NVDA are included: coin, side, size, notional dollars, entry price, mark price, unrealized profit and leverage, with a r

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_traders
tools.description: AlphaYou's Top list of Hyperliquid traders, best trader score first: rank, wallet address, trader score, Sharpe and all-time perp profit in dollars. Every trader on it has an account of at least $100,000 and at least $20,000 of all-time perp profit, so it is not every wallet. Pages of up to 25 rows

tools.name: alphayou_smart_money
tools.description: What funds (13F), insiders (Form 4), federal contract winners and top Hyperliquid traders are buying, selling or holding, for one US stock or as a discovery list. Pro depth: a year of filings and up to 25 rows a source. Congress trades and influencer posts are not available through the API. Filings

tools.name: alphayou_smart_money_overlap
tools.description: Where funds, insiders, contract awards and top Hyperliquid traders agree or conflict on one US stock: dated rows per category with each one's direction. Pro shows up to 10 rows a category. Congress and influencer posts are not included through the API. Descriptive only, not a score, a ranking or a b

tools.name: alphayou_stock_fundamentals
tools.description: Revenue, profit, EPS, assets, debt, cash and cash flow for one US company from stored SEC Company Facts, up to 24 periods with each metric's own dates and filing. No prices, valuation ratios or analyst estimates. Annual and interim periods must not be added together.

tools.name: alphayou_financial_quality
tools.description: Gross, operating, net and cash-flow margins and balance-sheet ratios for one US company, worked out only from matching verified SEC periods (up to 24). Mismatched periods stay unknown. No price, valuation, score or verdict.

tools.name: alphayou_company_earnings
tools.description: Company-reported earnings for one US company from stored SEC releases: GAAP and adjusted EPS, revenue, margins, segments and management guidance, up to 20 reports (default 8) with the original release links. No analyst estimates or beat/miss verdict.

tools.name: alphayou_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming company-announced US earnings dates from SEC 8-K announcements, for one ticker or a discovery list, 1 to 90 days ahead and up to 100 dates (default 25), each with its filing link and snippet. Not a complete market calendar; dates can change.

tools.name: alphayou_macro_context
tools.description: Latest stored US government macro readings with units and observation dates: Treasury yields and curve spreads, industrial production, the trade-weighted dollar, jobless claims, inflation, payrolls, retail sales, GDP, PCE and Fed liquidity parts. Raw levels, not a forecast or a regime score.

tools.name: alphayou_futures_positioning
tools.description: Weekly CFTC futures-only positioning for SPX (S&P 500), TY (10-year Treasury), WTI (crude oil) or GC (gold): long, short and net contracts per trader category and open interest, up to 52 reports (default 13). Contracts, not traders or dollars; reports lag trading.

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_wallet_analysis
tools.description: Past performance and risk of one public Hyperliquid wallet: trader score and confidence, 30-day and all-time profit, annualised return, max drawdown, worst week, Sharpe, Sortino and history length, with the analysis date. Past results are not what a follower would earn. Counts toward the new-wallet

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_compare_traders
tools.description: Two to five public Hyperliquid wallets side by side: score, profit, drawdown, worst week, Sharpe and Sortino, losses included. Past results are not what a follower would earn. Counts toward the new-wallet allowance.

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_activity
tools.description: Position opens, closes, flips and size changes seen among tracked traders over the last 1 to 168 hours, newest first, filterable by coin, wallet, event type and minimum position size (default $1,000,000; send 0 for all). Pages with next_cursor; pass since unchanged to keep the window fixed.

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_positioning
tools.description: Long and short size and position counts for one exact Hyperliquid market (BTC, xyz:NVDA) across the tracked trader group. Use alphayou_hyperliquid_resolve_market to get the exact symbol. Contracts, not share holdings.

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_market_state
tools.description: Mark price, 24-hour change, funding, open interest and volume for one Hyperliquid market, named the way a person would (Nvidia, BTC). Exchange context, not a quote for the underlying stock.

tools.name: alphayou_hyperliquid_resolve_market
tools.description: Match a name such as Nvidia or Bitcoin to the exact Hyperliquid market symbol (NVDA on a builder market is xyz:NVDA). Use before the positioning and activity tools. A stock-linked perpetual is a derivative, not a share.

tools.name: alphayou_fund_scoreboard
tools.description: Tracked funds ranked by the backtest return of their disclosed 13F holdings inside one window (4 years to 6 months), each against SPY over the same dates, as on alphayou.net/scoreboard, with the window's period, benchmark, method, as-of date, number of funds and full range. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: alphayou_smart_money · Private data: alphayou_insider_trades, alphayou_hyperliquid_wallets_positions, alphayou_hyperliquid_traders, alphayou_hyperliquid_wallet_analysis, alphayou_hyperliquid_compare_traders, alphayou_hyperliquid_activity · Public sink: alphayou_fund_holdings, alphayou_fund_changes, alphayou_ticker_holders, alphayou_top_traders, alphayou_hyperliquid_wallets_positions, alphayou_hyperliquid_activity, alphayou_hyperliquid_positioning, alphayou_hyperliquid_resolve_market.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: alphayou_smart_money · Private data: alphayou_insider_trades, alphayou_hyperliquid_wallets_positions, alphayou_hyperliquid_traders, alphayou_hyperliquid_wallet_analysis, alphayou_hyperliquid_compare_traders, alphayou_hyperliquid_activity · Public sink: alphayou_fund_holdings, alphayou_fund_changes, alphayou_ticker_holders, alphayou_top_traders, alphayou_hyperliquid_wallets_positions, alphayou_hyperliquid_activity, alphayou_hyperliquid_positioning, alphayou_hyperliquid_resolve_market

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
